complexity.notes: Clean and idiomatic one-liner style. Uses O(n) extra space for the filtered and reversed strings; a two-pointer scan over the original string would achieve O(1) auxiliary space, but at n <= 1000 this is irrelevant. Calling lower() before filtering lowercases non-alphanumeric characters unnecessarily, which is harmless but slightly wasteful.
complexity.summary: Filters the lowercased string down to alphanumeric characters, then checks whether the cleaned string equals its reverse.
